g.text: The unit does not report its Select Sound / Select Preset mode. Press M
to send Select Preset; remote preset selection also needs the unit's own
Preset Prog setting (system bank) ON. ⏎ selects the slot on the unit: a
Program Change first, then the button walk when it does not take.
⏎ picks a preset · r label · ctrl+r reload · esc / q to close
